bible: A top-down orienteering map in the international ISOM style, printed flat on smooth white map paper and seen perfectly from directly above, filling the whole frame edge to edge with no border, margin, frame, legend box, paper edge, fold or crease. Flat, even, shadowless light; no perspective, no 3D, no tilt. Crisp offset-print look: clean flat colour fills, very fine sharp linework, a faint even paper grain. Palette strictly limited to: paper white #FAFAF6 for open runnable forest (the dominant colour); pale yellow #FBE29A and saturated yellow #F5BB3C for open clearings and fields; light green #C7E7B4 and mid green #7FC87A for thickets, the green areas filled with fine parallel diagonal stripes; blue #5DBBE6 for lakes and ponds with a thin darker blue #1E8FCB shoreline; thin brown #B5622E contour lines that flow smoothly and never cross; black #1A1C19 for thin dashed footpaths, small dot boulders and short toothed cliff lines. Nothing else. Consistent series: every image uses exactly this palette, line weight and level of detail. Exclude: no text, no letters, no numbers, no place names, no labels, no legend, no north arrow, no north lines, no scale bar, no compass, no grid lines, no purple or magenta anything, no circles, triangles or course markings, no symbols or icons, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no hands, no objects lying on the map.

shots.hero: 21:9 landscape, at least 2400px wide. The left 42% of the frame is a calm, nearly empty area of white open forest: only three or four faint, widely spaced brown contour lines and one thin black dashed path curving gently through it, kept very quiet and pale, as the clean zone for a headline and a paragraph in the top-left. All the detail lives in the right 58%: exactly six distinct, well-separated saturated-yellow open clearings of different rounded organic shapes, each roughly 6 to 9% of the frame width, each plain flat yellow inside with clear white forest around it, spread over the right side at varied heights; one blue lake with a darker blue shoreline at centre-right, about 10% of the frame width, plain flat blue inside; two green striped thicket patches between clearings; a small hill of tight concentric brown contours in the upper right; thin black dashed paths linking several clearings. The bottom 20% across the full width stays light: white forest with only sparse contour lines, so a card can overlap it.
shots.week: 3:2 landscape, a companion sheet of different terrain in the same style. A clear route-friendly landscape running in a gentle arc from lower-left to upper-right: a black dashed path junction near the lower-left corner, then five small, distinct, well-spaced features along the arc (a small yellow clearing, a cluster of black dot boulders, a small blue pond, a sharp V-shaped bend in the brown contour lines, the corner of a green striped thicket), ending at a larger plain yellow clearing near the upper-right. Leave clear white forest around each feature. The top-left quarter and the bottom-right quarter stay mostly white with only faint sparse contours, as clean zones. Overall density medium, lighter than a busy map.
shots.finale: 21:9 landscape, same style. One large plain flat yellow clearing, about 22% of the frame width, sitting centre-right in the lower half, its interior completely empty flat yellow; a ring of green striped thicket around part of its edge and a gentle curve of brown contour lines wrapping it; one thin black dashed path arriving at it from the lower left. Everything else is quiet white forest with sparse faint contours; the top 40% across the full width is especially empty, as the clean zone for a closing headline.
